summary: Iteration 31 — targeted retest of the two follow-ups from iteration_30. (1) Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_marketing_studio.py run with `pytest -n0` — 17/17 PASSED in 21s (auth, seeded gallery, image serving, generate/delete, validation, admin regression). The gemini-3.6-flash copy-model fix from iteration_30 is intact — live post generation still returns 200 with real copy + hashtags. (2) Rebrand verified: sidebar tagline is now 'MARKETPLACE AUTOPILOT · RECON', <title> = 'Fundle Marketplace AutoPilot · Reconciliation', meta description = 'Fundle Marketplace AutoPilot — Reconciliation Platform', and a global grep of the rendered DOM returns 0 matches for 'Finance OS' (also verified clean on /reports and /reconciliation). NOTE: the index.html change was NOT live until I restarted the frontend — CRA's dev-server was serving a cached copy of public/index.html (see rca_of_the_issue); source was correct all along. (3) Clipboard fix verified thoroughly with 16 assertions: without granted permissions Chromium actually auto-granted the write, so I additionally force-stubbed navigator.clipboard.writeText to reject — the document.execCommand('copy') fallback fires and shows the success toast; when BOTH paths are made to fail the error toast 'Copy failed — please copy manually' renders with NO false success toast. In every case: 0 CRA error-overlay iframes, 0 unhandled promise rejections / pageerrors, and the marketing-create-open dialog trigger remained clickable afterwards. With permissions granted, readClipboardText() exactly equals linkedin_text + '\n\n' + hashtags.join(' ') (517 chars, byte-for-byte match). Both iteration_30 blockers are resolved; no new issues found.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_30 follow-ups (rebrand strings + clipboard error handling) are CONFIRMED FIXED — do not retest unless the files change. Run backend regression with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_marketing_studio.py -n0` (pytest.ini forces xdist; -n0 preserves create->delete ordering); it takes ~21s and should be 17/17. IMPORTANT gotcha: after any edit to /app/frontend/public/index.html you MUST restart the frontend or you will see the stale cached title/meta and report a false negative. Chromium in this harness auto-grants clipboard-write to the focused tab, so to exercise the execCommand fallback you must stub navigator.clipboard.writeText to reject via page.evaluate + Object.defineProperty. Remaining known-unfixed low-priority items: PostCard image fetch has no .catch, orphan PNG on failed generation, opaque 500 on LLM failure, dead code in routers/marketing.py.
rca_of_the_issue: First rebrand run FAILED on <title> ('Fundle Finance OS · Marketplace Reconciliation') and meta description even though /app/frontend/public/index.html on disk already contained the corrected strings. curl against both the public URL and localhost:3000 returned the stale markup, proving it was not a browser cache. Root cause: create-react-app's webpack-dev-server generates index.html via HtmlWebpackPlugin at startup and does not add public/index.html to the watch set, so the in-memory HTML remained the pre-fix version from before the main agent's edit. `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` regenerated it and all title/meta/DOM-grep assertions then passed. This is an environment/dev-server artifact, not an application defect — a production build would embed the correct strings.
